## Libraries and Data
```{r}
#install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)

install_github("sjterian/Watershed-metrics") #creator/repo name

library(watershedmetrics)
ls("package:watershedmetrics") #list functions to make sure that it worked

```

load the Gu data to use as an example for the package
```{r}
data = read.csv("data/Gu_StreamWaterChemistry_processed.csv")
date_col = "Date"
site_col = "Site"



```
